list.label: QoO score data sources
list.query: passive : passive,active-ping : active-ping,active-iperf3 : active-iperf3,active-godash : active-godash,active-network-quality : active-network-quality,active-libreqos : active-libreqos

options.content: Configure Network Open Browser Docker Configure QoO Active Passive Overall QoO Sources

Per-profile QoO timelines
Use QoO profiles multi-select at top. Each selected profile gets one row with timeline (left) and threshold config (right).

targets.query:
import "strings"
selectedProfile = "${qooProfiles}"
sel = ${sources:json}
rollingWindow = duration(v: "${qooRollingWindow}")

passiveOn = contains(value: "passive", set: sel)
pingOn = contains(value: "active-ping", set: sel)
iperfOn = contains(value: "active-iperf3", set: sel)
godashOn = contains(value: "active-godash", set: sel)
nqOn = contains(value: "active-network-quality", set: sel)
libreqosOn = contains(value: "active-libreqos", set: sel)

latencyCapable = passiveOn or pingOn or godashOn or nqOn or libreqosOn
lossCapable = passiveOn or pingOn or godashOn
throughputCapable = passiveOn or iperfOn or nqOn or libreqosOn

cfg = from(bucket: "qoo")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_config_profile" and r.name == selectedProfile)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

enabledPercentiles = strings.split(v: string(v: cfg.qooLatencyPercentilesCsv), t: ",")

componentScore = (measured, lower, upper) => {
  m = 1.0 - (measured - lower) / (upper - lower)
  clamped = if m < 0.0 then 0.0 else if m > 1.0 then 1.0 else m
  return clamped * 100.0
}

latencyBase = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "passive")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => passiveOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_ping_sample_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => pingOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "active" and r.bandwidth == "false")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => godashOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  ,from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_network_quality_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.mode == "active" and r.source == "network-quality" and r.phase == "loaded")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => nqOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  ,from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_libreqos_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.mode == "active" and r.source == "libreqos")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => libreqosOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
])

mkLatency = (q, lower, upper, label) =>
  latencyBase
    |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
    |> quantile(q: q, method: "exact_selector")
    |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
    |> window(every: inf)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: componentScore(measured: r._value, lower: lower, upper: upper), label: label}))

latencyRowsAll = union(tables: [
  mkLatency(q: 0.50, lower: float(v: cfg.qooLatencyP50Lower), upper: float(v: cfg.qooLatencyP50Upper), label: "Latency P50 QoO"),
  mkLatency(q: 0.95, lower: float(v: cfg.qooLatencyP95Lower), upper: float(v: cfg.qooLatencyP95Upper), label: "Latency P95 QoO"),
  mkLatency(q: 0.99, lower: float(v: cfg.qooLatencyP99Lower), upper: float(v: cfg.qooLatencyP99Upper), label: "Latency P99 QoO")
])

latencyRows = latencyRowsAll
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    (r.label == "Latency P50 QoO" and contains(value: "p50", set: enabledPercentiles)) or
    (r.label == "Latency P95 QoO" and contains(value: "p95", set: enabledPercentiles)) or
    (r.label == "Latency P99 QoO" and contains(value: "p99", set: enabledPercentiles))
  )

lossBase = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_loss_ratio" and r.mode == "passive")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => passiveOn)
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "flow"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.packets >= 0.0)
    |> rename(columns: {value: "_value"})
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_loss_ratio" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "active" and r.bandwidth == "true")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => pingOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_loss_ratio" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "active" and r.bandwidth == "false")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => godashOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
])

lossRow = lossBase
  |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
  |> mean()
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: componentScore(measured: r._value, lower: float(v: cfg.qooLossLower), upper: float(v: cfg.qooLossUpper)), label: "Loss QoO"}))

throughputBase = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_throughput_mbps" and r.mode == "passive")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => passiveOn)
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "flow"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.value >= 0.0 and r.packets >= 0.0)
    |> rename(columns: {value: "_value"})
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_throughput_mbps" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "active" and r.bandwidth == "true")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => iperfOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  ,from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_network_quality_throughput_mbps" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.mode == "active" and r.source == "network-quality")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => nqOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  ,from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_libreqos_throughput_mbps" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.mode == "active" and r.source == "libreqos")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => libreqosOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
])

throughputRow = throughputBase
  |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
  |> min()
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r._value >= float(v: cfg.qooMinThroughputMbps) then 100.0 else 0.0, label: "Throughput QoO"}))

timeAnchor = union(tables: [
  latencyRows |> keep(columns: ["_time"]),
  lossRow |> keep(columns: ["_time"]),
  throughputRow |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
])
  |> group()
  |> unique(column: "_time")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

latencyFixedRow = if latencyCapable then timeAnchor |> filter(fn: (r) => false) else timeAnchor |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: 100.0, label: "Latency QoO (fixed)"}))
lossFixedRow = if lossCapable then timeAnchor |> filter(fn: (r) => false) else timeAnchor |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: 100.0, label: "Loss QoO (fixed)"}))
throughputFixedRow = if throughputCapable then timeAnchor |> filter(fn: (r) => false) else timeAnchor |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: 100.0, label: "Throughput QoO (fixed)"}))

componentRows = union(tables: [latencyRows, lossRow, throughputRow, latencyFixedRow, lossFixedRow, throughputFixedRow])

overallRow = componentRows
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> min(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, label: "Overall QoO"}))

union(tables: [componentRows, overallRow])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.label}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

import "array"
import "strings"
selectedProfile = "${qooProfiles}"

cfg = from(bucket: "qoo")
  |> range(start: -3650d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_config_profile" and r.name == selectedProfile)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

enabled = strings.split(v: string(v: cfg.qooLatencyPercentilesCsv), t: ",")

headRows = array.from(rows: [
  {ord: 1, line: "Latency"},
  {ord: 2, line: "Percentiles: " + string(v: cfg.qooLatencyPercentilesCsv)}
])
emptyRows = headRows |> filter(fn: (r) => false)

p50Rows = if contains(value: "p50", set: enabled) then array.from(rows: [{ord: 3, line: "P50: CPUP " + string(v: cfg.qooLatencyP50Lower) + ", ROP " + string(v: cfg.qooLatencyP50Upper)}]) else emptyRows
p95Rows = if contains(value: "p95", set: enabled) then array.from(rows: [{ord: 4, line: "P95: CPUP " + string(v: cfg.qooLatencyP95Lower) + ", ROP " + string(v: cfg.qooLatencyP95Upper)}]) else emptyRows
p99Rows = if contains(value: "p99", set: enabled) then array.from(rows: [{ord: 5, line: "P99: CPUP " + string(v: cfg.qooLatencyP99Lower) + ", ROP " + string(v: cfg.qooLatencyP99Upper)}]) else emptyRows

tailRows = array.from(rows: [
  {ord: 6, line: "Loss"},
  {ord: 7, line: "CPUP " + string(v: cfg.qooLossLower) + ", ROP " + string(v: cfg.qooLossUpper)},
  {ord: 8, line: "Minimum Bandwidth"},
  {ord: 9, line: string(v: cfg.qooMinThroughputMbps) + " Mbps"}
])

union(tables: [headRows, p50Rows, p95Rows, p99Rows, tailRows])
  |> sort(columns: ["ord"])
